text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make the code easier to read and understand, so other developers can work with it more easily. Refactoring helps reduce technical debt, which is the extra work that builds up when code is written quickly and poorly. By cleaning up the code, teams can fix bugs faster and add new features with less effort. It is important to remember that refactoring should never change how the program behaves. Tests help make sure the software still works correctly after the changes.
